_documentation: Action outputs: policy briefs, peer-reviewed papers, reports, training materials. Hand-maintained. Consumed by two renderers: assets/js/outputs-publications.js drives the visible list on outputs.html (+ FR + DE), and assets/js/working-groups.js surfaces entries under the matching sections on working-groups.html via the `workingGroups: [n,...]` tag array (the same mechanism events.json uses). While `publications` is empty both pages show their 'first publications expected October 2026' placeholders, so publishing the first output is purely a data entry task here. Entry fields: `type` is one of policy-brief | article | report | training-material | dataset (label translations live in the renderers); `title` is a locale map {en,fr,de} following the events.json convention; `authors` is an array of display names, and any name matching a directory member (the same first|last name-matching the faculty cards use) links to their people-page profile automatically; `date` is an ISO year-month string for sorting; `url` is optional (omit for not-yet-public records); `doi` is optional and becomes the link when `url` is absent; `deliverable` is optional (e.g. 'D6') and renders as a labelled marker; `workingGroups` is the [n,...] tag array for the WG page. Author names are matched to directory members by first plus last name, and the matcher also reads the surname-first spellings a reference list uses ("A. Lovelace", "Lovelace, Ada", "Lovelace, A.P.B.", "LOVELACE Ada"), so a bibliographic entry still connects. It refuses an initial that fits two members rather than guessing between them. Any author it cannot resolve is listed in data/network-map.json's stats.authors_unmatched, which is where to look if a co-authorship tie you expected did not appear.
